criteria.expected: Case A should not wait for final P merely because P is unavailable; use/validate N now because N is explicitly target-preserving for the exact decision.

Case B may genuinely defer only final target adjudication because no current target-preserving discriminator exists and a concrete future P evidence route is reachable; useful side research continues.

Case C is not a justified passive-wait case: no current discriminator and no established future P evidence route; return to active support/carrier/authority search or reframe the claim rather than pretend an outcome is on the way.

Case D separates an unvalidated correlated proxy from a target-preserving substitute; final P adjudication can wait while Q transport validation, calibration/identity audit and rival preregistration proceed now.
General rule contains both necessary coordinates: current target-preserving discriminator/substitute status AND reachable future target-process evidence support; calendar delay alone is insufficient.
Explicitly separates waiting for final adjudication from waiting to do research/action.
At least two tempting wrong policies are rejected, including variants of wait-whenever-answer-missing, never-wait, or treat any proxy as sufficient.
Reclassification evidence is case-relative and can change current-substitute validity or future-route reachability without rewriting past observations.

invalidApparatusRule: Any pre-Provider/Provider/structured-output failure is apparatus evidence only and cannot be scored as research failure without a valid actor result.
prohibitedOverclaims: No universal claim that waiting is always irrational.
No universal claim that any future scheduled observation makes waiting optimal regardless of current substitutes or decision deadlines.
No claim that correlated Q is decision-preserving before transport/validation.
No claim that Case C has a future P outcome merely because the target process is conceptually defined.
